setName: Yu-Gi-Oh! Dark Duel Stories promotional cards

Prismatic Secret Rare.name: Acid Trap Hole
Prismatic Secret Rare.desc: Target 1 face-down Defense Position monster on the field; flip it face-up, then destroy it if its DEF is 2000 or less, or return it face-down if its DEF is more than 2000.

Prismatic Secret Rare.name: Blue-Eyes White Dragon
Prismatic Secret Rare.desc: This legendary dragon is a powerful engine of destruction. Virtually invincible, very few have faced this awesome creature and lived to tell the tale.

Prismatic Secret Rare.name: Dark Magician
Prismatic Secret Rare.desc: ''The ultimate wizard in terms of attack and defense.''

Prismatic Secret Rare.name: Exodia the Forbidden One
Prismatic Secret Rare.desc: If you have "Right Leg of the Forbidden One", "Left Leg of the Forbidden One", "Right Arm of the Forbidden One" and "Left Arm of the Forbidden One" in addition to this card in your hand, you win the Duel.

Prismatic Secret Rare.name: Salamandra
Prismatic Secret Rare.desc: Equip only to a FIRE monster. It gains 700 ATK.

Prismatic Secret Rare.name: Seiyaryu
Prismatic Secret Rare.desc: A mystical dragon that burns away the unworthy with its mystic flames.
